title: Apply for the EDUFI -internship at FIME!
content:
FIME is looking for a university intern to Beirut for spring 2027 through the Finnish National Board of Education’s EDUFI application.

An internship at FIME offers an interesting perspective on the work of a research institute in the Middle East. The intern will support the institute’s operations by assisting with a diverse set of tasks including: active participation in organizing the institute’s events and courses, and in the practical implementation of the institute’s communications. In terms of communications, the institute’s website and social media channels (Instagram, Facebook) in particular are part of the intern’s focus areas. In addition, finding writers for Paikan päältä -blog, curating and maintaining the digital photo archive are among the intern’s duties. The intern can also perform research assistant tasks. The intern will be given diverse set of tasks that are quite demanding.

NOTE! In case there is not a possibility to carry out the internsip in Beirut, a new estimate of the internship’s place of execution will be made as soon as possible.

Fluency in Finnish and English languages is required.
